title: UPDATE and DELETE
summary: UPDATE changes rows matching WHERE; DELETE removes them. Both are dangerous without WHERE — they affect EVERY row in the table.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: UPDATE changes rows matching WHERE; DELETE removes them. Both are dangerous without WHERE — they affect EVERY row in the table.
Always preview with SELECT first using the same WHERE clause. Transactions let you rollback mistakes.
Key points: UPDATE t SET col = val WHERE cond, DELETE FROM t WHERE cond, and there is no undo without backups/transactions.

sections.codeExample:
UPDATE users SET age = 31 WHERE name = 'Amy';
DELETE FROM logs WHERE created_at < '2020-01-01';
